## Description

This script processes **skipped exon (SE)** events identified by **rMATS** to generate corresponding **peptide sequences** for both **inclusion** and **exclusion** isoforms.

### Load required packages

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

# Load required libraries
library(rprojroot)
library(tidyverse)
library(Biostrings)
library(rtracklayer)
library(GenomicFeatures)
library(glue)
```

### Set directory paths

```{r dir paths}
root_dir <- find_root(has_dir(".git"))
data_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "data")
analysis_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "analyses", "splicing-translation")
input_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "inputs")
results_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "results")
```

### Inputs

```{r}
gtf_file <- file.path(data_dir, "gencode.v39.primary_assembly.annotation.gtf.gz")
genome_fa <- file.path(data_dir, "GRCh38.primary_assembly.genome.fa.gz")
rMATS_file <- file.path(input_dir, "fromGTF.SE.txt")
output_fasta <- file.path(results_dir, "rMATS_SE_peptides_test.fasta")
```

### Load genome

```{r}
genome <- readDNAStringSet(genome_fa)
names(genome) <- sub(" .*", "", names(genome))
```

### Load GTF, filter for CDS

```{r}
gtf <- import(gtf_file)
gtf_exons <- gtf[gtf$type == "CDS"]   
gtf_exons_df <- as.data.frame(gtf_exons) %>%
  dplyr::select(seqnames, start, end, strand, phase, gene_id, gene_name)
```

### Load rMATS SE file

```{r}
rMATS <- read.table(rMATS_file, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Subset only 5 events for testing
set.seed(123)
rMATS_test <- rMATS %>% slice_sample(n = 5)
```

```{r}
# Helper function: get phase for exon
get_phase <- function(chr, start_pos, end_pos, strand, gtf_df) {
  exon <- gtf_df %>%
    filter(seqnames == chr, start == start_pos, end == end_pos, strand == strand)
  if (nrow(exon) > 0) {
    return(as.integer(exon$phase[1]))
  } else {
    return(0)  # Default phase 0 if not found
  }
}
```

```{r}
# Helper function: get exon sequence
get_exon_seq <- function(chr, start_pos, end_pos, strand, genome) {
  seq <- genome[[chr]][start_pos:end_pos]
  if (strand == "-") {
    seq <- reverseComplement(seq)
  }
  return(seq)
}
```

```{r}
# Start timing
start_time <- Sys.time()
```

```{r}
# Initialize list to store peptides
peptide_list <- list()
```

```{r}
# Process each event
for (i in 1:nrow(rMATS_test)) {
  
  event <- rMATS_test[i, ]
  
  chr <- event$chr
  strand <- event$strand
  
  # Correct 0-based to 1-based
  up_start <- event$upstreamES + 1
  up_end <- event$upstreamEE
  
  alt_start <- event$exonStart_0base + 1
  alt_end <- event$exonEnd
  
  down_start <- event$downstreamES + 1
  down_end <- event$downstreamEE
  
  # Extract sequences
  up_seq <- get_exon_seq(chr, up_start, up_end, strand, genome)
  alt_seq <- get_exon_seq(chr, alt_start, alt_end, strand, genome)
  down_seq <- get_exon_seq(chr, down_start, down_end, strand, genome)
  
  # Get phases
  phase_up <- get_phase(chr, up_start, up_end, strand, gtf_exons_df)
  phase_alt <- get_phase(chr, alt_start, alt_end, strand, gtf_exons_df)
  phase_down <- get_phase(chr, down_start, down_end, strand, gtf_exons_df)
  
  # Assemble inclusion and exclusion isoforms
  inclusion_seq <- if (strand == "+") {
    xscat(up_seq, alt_seq, down_seq)
  } else {
    xscat(down_seq, alt_seq, up_seq)
  }
  
  exclusion_seq <- if (strand == "+") {
    xscat(up_seq, down_seq)
  } else {
    xscat(down_seq, up_seq)
  }
  
  # Phase correction
  if (strand == "+") {
    if (phase_up == 1) inclusion_seq <- subseq(inclusion_seq, 2)
    if (phase_up == 2) inclusion_seq <- subseq(inclusion_seq, 3)
    
    if (phase_up == 1) exclusion_seq <- subseq(exclusion_seq, 2)
    if (phase_up == 2) exclusion_seq <- subseq(exclusion_seq, 3)
  } else {
    if (phase_down == 1) inclusion_seq <- subseq(inclusion_seq, 2)
    if (phase_down == 2) inclusion_seq <- subseq(inclusion_seq, 3)
    
    if (phase_down == 1) exclusion_seq <- subseq(exclusion_seq, 2)
    if (phase_down == 2) exclusion_seq <- subseq(exclusion_seq, 3)
  }
  
  # Translate
  peptide_inclusion <- translate(inclusion_seq, if.fuzzy.codon = "X")
  peptide_exclusion <- translate(exclusion_seq, if.fuzzy.codon = "X")
  
  # Create AAStringSet from single AAString
  peptide_inclusion_set <- AAStringSet(peptide_inclusion)
  peptide_exclusion_set <- AAStringSet(peptide_exclusion)
  
  # Assign names
  id_base <- glue("event_{event$ID}_{event$geneSymbol}")
  names(peptide_inclusion_set) <- glue("{id_base}_inclusion")
  names(peptide_exclusion_set) <- glue("{id_base}_exclusion")
  
  # Store
  peptide_list[[length(peptide_list) + 1]] <- peptide_inclusion_set
  peptide_list[[length(peptide_list) + 1]] <- peptide_exclusion_set
}
```

```{r}
# End timing
end_time <- Sys.time()
runtime <- end_time - start_time
```

```{r}
# Combine peptides
peptides <- do.call(c, peptide_list)
```

```{r}
# Write to FASTA
writeXStringSet(peptides, filepath = output_fasta, format = "fasta")
```

```{r}
# Print runtime
print(glue("Total runtime for 5 events: {runtime}"))
```
